output.headline: The insurer rejected your claim, but it seems wrong and can be challenged.
what_happened: Your family member was in the hospital from October 20 to October 24, 2026, for a right knee replacement due to osteoarthritis.
Suraksha Health Insurance Co. rejected the claim.
They said it was because of the pre-existing disease waiting period.
why: Your policy states a 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period for osteoarthritis.
However, you have had continuous insurance cover for 40 months, which is more than the waiting period.
This means the waiting period was already completed when the treatment took place.
Also, IRDAI rules cap the maximum waiting period for such conditions at 36 months.
Therefore, the insurer's rejection appears incorrect.
next_steps: The hospital desk will help you prepare an appeal to Suraksha Health Insurance Co.
You should not pay the {{totals.billed}} difference to the hospital yet.
Keep all your policy papers and hospital bills safe.
We expect to recover {{flag.WAITING_REJECTION_INVALID.recoverable}} for you.
output.reassurance: We are working to get this decision changed for you.
